UI_BSS_AddTooltip: Safehouse storage supplies ingredients for crafting and cooking and accepts items from auto-sort.
UI_BSS_SortInventoryTooltip: Moves carried items into safehouse storage: first to a container that already holds that item, then to the first one with free space.
UI_BSS_NoTargets: The safehouse has no containers set up to accept items
UI_BSS_Err_nosquare: Safehouse: that map chunk is not loaded
UI_BSS_Err_permission: Safehouse: only the owner or an admin can change this
UI_BSS_Err_notregistered: Safehouse: that container is not added
UI_BSS_Deny_outside_base: Storage is usable only inside the safehouse
UI_BSS_Deny_not_registered: That container is not part of the safehouse and is too far away
